blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — Another 100 freshly laid sea turtle eggs were collected Sunday morning along the shores of Tayabas Bay in Sariyaya, Quezon, bringing the total number of eggs gathered during the current nesting season to 195. “We’re expecting more eggs in the coming days,” Edwin Frias, a deputized fish warden and member of the local “bantay dagat,” told the Inquirer in an online interview. Frias said conservation workers found the eggs along the shoreline of Barangay Bignay 2, the same site where they also found 95 eggs on Sept. 25.
